Different frozen subsets cannot be used as backend speed ratios. The diagnostic 90% duration rule is distinct from the main paired 95% rule.

private_diagnostics.text: An isolated development build of the TIRust bridge tries 256-bit MPFR first and retries once at 512 bits only for a narrowly identified conditioning refusal. Fortran inputs remain genuine 113-bit QP. Twenty Rust tests pass, including real full/poles tensor kernels and injected failure/cache controls. The separate shared library is built; these tests did not load it through Fortran. Mixed-tier physical amplitudes, dynamic transport, IEEE/trap behavior and performance remain unqualified. It is not installed as the production backend used in this campaign.
private_diagnostics.title: Experimental adaptive-precision bridge

private_diagnostics.text: Sixteen private exports compile; 51 controlled Fortran checks pass. Twelve ordinary real/CMS legacy runs preserve every compared coefficient exactly. Sixteen fixed-QP runs establish the requested Born/coordinate view, including 24 exact full-arm observations; status 120 is unchecked. No backend 8/9, retained stress amplitude or performance qualification follows from this milestone.
private_diagnostics.title: Born/effective-point consistency

private_diagnostics.text: The production installer still accepts boolean values as integer ABI/schema versions; two regression tests remain deliberately failing while the campaign source is frozen. An isolated two-guard correction passes 27 installer/card tests and two extra float-version rejection checks. It has not been applied to production. The passed installed-ABI row covers its identified earlier test groups, not all integration audits.
private_diagnostics.title: Installer metadata hardening remains open

private_diagnostics.text: All six 100-point lanes pass 3e-6. TIRust accepts 14 points in DP and 86 in QP. The 1e-8 target is missed at 45 distinct points by at least one candidate reducer; original discrepancies and all pairwise comparisons remain retained. No independent finite/single-pole truth or higher-precision adjudication is supplied by this read-only triage.
private_diagnostics.title: QCD n4 target misses

statistics.scope: One retained invocation passed 10 tests and four compiled synthetic Fortran tally/writer subtests, using current production Python readers. Legacy aliases, TIRust/NinjaRS precision counters and aggregation are covered. This qualifies the identified statistics sources; it neither recovers the historical unbound 92-pass invocation nor establishes amplitude, native-reducer or performance results.

stress.text: Historical 49af, private mass-transport prototype. QP squaring of existing MP masses reduces the recorded group-5 Gram discrepancy from 1.018% to 1.60e-20, while both arms still refuse 37 threshold tensor parents. Status 120 and accuracy −1 are unchecked; the TIRust sum is incomplete. Matching successful scalar/rank-one subsets does not qualify the failed tensors, full amplitude or performance.

stress.scope: Pinned retained diagnostic; scientific adjudication is not rerun by the report
stress.text: Historical 49af, six private replays. Topology correction plus Born evaluation at repaired coordinates gives NinjaRS status 322 and a 1.33e-15 analytic double-pole error; topology-only status 322 still misses 3e-6. Finite/single-pole truth remains unavailable. TIRust retains 51 nonsingular conditioning refusals and failed status 420; its incomplete sums are not amplitudes accepted for physics.

This is a synthetic host-helper fixture, not a physical amplitude. The production default remains unchanged; the registered qualification policy is 1e-6.

Retained independent QP comparisons support a CutTools DP reference bias and a smaller Ninja/NinjaRS discrepancy at point 39; a reducer cluster alone is not truth. Those historical fixed-QP results are unchecked status 120, not an automatic-rescue certificate. Original comparisons and acceptance gates are unchanged.

stress.text: A separate private all-512-bit replay completed 232 tensor calls with actual runtime mapping and exact ordinary-point parity. It changes arithmetic precision and its admission gate jointly. Forty-six contracted tensor slots retain relative discrepancies, despite close final projections. It does not qualify the adaptive 256-to-512 library or general physical accuracy.
stress.title: QCD higher precision

limitations: This is an untimed cache-lifecycle qualification, not the eight-process/five-reducer performance acceptance campaign.
Two QCD Born subprocesses and generated N<=3/R<=2 are covered; rank-six, EW, loop-induced and poles-only behavior are not qualified by this experiment.
Physical calls use native DP with independent stability rechecks; QP coverage is confined to explicit tensor-key diagnostics.
The QP key fixtures do not test a nonzero binary128-only mass/scale/shift perturbation.
Born host tensor caching is disabled/dummy here; observed automatic native TIRust clears are real.
Portable replay verifies retained text/maps; live binary/source/runtime validation was performed and retained by the execution binder and independent audit.
Runtime closure was bound with linker maps and ldd before/after execution; no /proc runtime-map capture was performed.

parity.physical_precision: native double precision; no QP rescue occurred
parity.qp_scope: Separate genuine-QP generated tensor diagnostics,12 calls per worker; mass,scale and test shift inputs are DP values promoted to QP.

prior_attempts.outcome: Build query failed because makefile /bin/bash did not exist.
Plain link succeeded, then provenance gate rejected an unbound compiler-selected linker script; no native worker.
First worker stopped before LC_OPEN/amplitude because bare card path could not find ident_card.dat.
Nominal card smoke passed; alternate long numeric token was truncated by CHARACTER*20 reader. No physical worker.

subprocess_event_cache_lifecycle.scope: Four fresh workers each evaluate 19 checked native-DP physical calls and 24 separate DP/QP tensor-key requests across two subprocess prefixes. Coefficients, status, accuracy, inputs and IEEE state agree exactly with caching enabled/disabled and observation enabled/disabled. Each observed worker records 38 automatic physical-boundary clears and two context generations. QP coverage is confined to tensor-key diagnostics; this N≤3, rank≤2 experiment makes no physical-QP-rescue, rank-six, EW, poles-only or timing claim.

verification.scope: Portable retained-text/map replay; no live binary requalification.
